messages:
Samir Patel: Hey team — monitor arrived but the VESA plate is missing and the USB-C->Ethernet dongle in the kit isn't enumerating on my M2 Mac. Ticket created: #IT-4389. @Jordan (IT) can you help? :wave:

Jordan (IT): Thanks Samir — on it. Can you confirm the model numbers on the box and whether you have the USB-A dongle too? Also what's the output of `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` or `ifconfig -a`? If easier I can swap a dongle from stock.

Samir Patel: Box label says "ViewSonic VP2768a" and dongle model printed as "BCM2045" on the tiny sticker. Quick `ifconfig` shows nothing for en0. Screenshot of adapter plugged in: https://imgur.com/abc123 (adapter not detected). No USB-A dongle in the shipment.

OnboardingBot: Ticket IT-4389 assigned to Jordan (IT). Replacement dongle shipment scheduled — expedited next-business-day. Tracking: https://shipco.example/track/ZX123. Estimated delivery: tomorrow.

Emma Lee: Welcome Samir! If you need a temporary monitor I can bring the spare from my desk this afternoon — saves you waiting. Ping me and I'll drop it at your desk.

Jordan (IT): Samir — can you try an NVRAM reset and SMC reset, then run `sudo dmesg | grep -i usb` and paste the output here? If it's a Broadcom firmware glitch we will swap. I'll also put a VESA plate on Emma's spare so you can mount it quickly.

Samir Patel: Tried SMC/NVRAM, `dmesg` shows: "usb 2-1: device not accepting address" and a firmware error line referencing brcmfmac. Happy to take Emma's spare for the afternoon. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
